thread:
olivia: Heads-up — we need to lock the observability launch surface for the next sprint. customers are pushing for dashboards + cost breakdown + basic trace hooks. can we align scope today?

mike: +1. Which parts are must-have vs nice-to-have? I want clear launch gates.

sarah: From support: customers care most about three views: per-route latency P95, token cost per-model, and top error buckets by service. tracing hooks are requested but can be phased.

dan: Agree with Sarah. If we can't ship full distributed tracing, at minimum we should expose a lightweight request-id -> trace link so apps can correlate.

olivia: Proposed gates: 1) dashboards with P95/P99 and cost per-route, 2) error analytics grouped by error class + example traces, 3) basic trace link surface + instrumentation guide. Anything else?

emma: Add a rollout requirement: must be toggleable per-org and off by default. enterprise customers will want to opt-in first.

mike: What about cost visibility granularity? token-level vs token-range? customers asked for top-line $ per route and a token-percentile. detailed token logs can be behind advanced billing.
sarah: For launch MVP let's do aggregated cost buckets (daily per-route, model, trimmed) + sample top-10 callers. fine to keep raw logs for later.

dan: Dependency check: backend needs a new telemetry event: model_cost_estimate on response. infra ETA? @mike can you confirm?
mike: infra: we'll add model_cost_estimate to the response envelope. PR target end of week. it adds ~5% payload. need opt-in flag for private deployments.

observability-bot: New deployment alert: telemetry-schema v2 pushed to staging by mike at 2026-02-14T10:03Z :rocket:

olivia: Good. Can we define concrete acceptance criteria for error analytics? e.g., automatically cluster stack traces by signature, show top-5 buckets, ability to click into 3 sample traces.
sarah: Yes. Acceptance: clustering by message+top-frame, show counts and change delta vs baseline, ability to open sample traces (if tracing linked). If no traces, show request-id + timestamp and provide instrumentation doc.

emma: UX note — dashboard should default to 24h -> 7d, with quick toggles for 1h and 30d. Keep initial widgets to 5 to avoid clutter.
dan: Rollout plan: canary 10% orgs (internal + beta customers) -> monitor cost/error delta -> 100%. fallback path if cost spike > 20% or error surface increases by > 10% within 24h.
mike: Also add a perf safety net: tracing hooks must not increase request latency by >4ms p95. we'll run perf tests during canary.
olivia: Prioritization: ship dashboards + cost agg + error clustering in sprint A. tracing link + instrumentation guide in sprint B. Is that reasonable?
sarah: Sprint A tasks: dashboard queries, cost aggregation job, error-clusterer lambda, UI tiles, backend schema. I estimate 3 engs for 2 weeks.
emma: Product asks for one example customer-runbook describing how to triage a cost spike using the new surface. I'll draft.
dan: One open question: privacy/compliance for sample traces in Private deployments. we need a flag to redact payloads and sample-only show metadata.
mike: we'll add a redaction mode and an enterprise toggle. config snippet for telemetry envelope for instrumentation guide: 
```json
{
  "request_id": "string",
  "model": "redwood-1",
  "tokens_out": 123,
  "model_cost_estimate": 0.0042,
  "error_class": null
}
```

olivia: Nice. Can everyone add their top 2 blockers by EOD? I'll consolidate into a trimmed launch checklist and send to execs.
sarah: Blockers: 1) accurate cost mapping per model variant, 2) stable clustering threshold for errors.
emma: Blockers: 1) UX polish for widget resizing, 2) runbook draft.
mike: Blockers: 1) ensure schema v2 doesn't break older clients, 2) perf budget validation during canary.
dan: Blockers: 1) private deployment redaction flow, 2) tests for sampling correctness.
olivia: Thanks — I'll compile and schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow. :calendar: If no objections, we'll treat tracing full spans as post-launch.

observability-bot: Reminder: sprint A kickoff meeting scheduled 2026-02-16T09:00Z.

mike: sounds good. i'll open PRs for schema + canary infra today.
sarah: I'll start the clustering PoC and share results by Wed.
emma: I'll prototype the runbook and sample dashboard layout.
dan: I'll draft the instrumentation doc and the privacy redaction spec.
olivia: Great — thanks team. small follow-up: please add any customer asks (with customer name & priority) as replies to this thread so I can include them in the stakeholder brief. :pray:
